basic_info.description: Marcus & Millichap is pleased to present this spacious 4,040 square foot four-unit property, a rare value-add opportunity in the highly desirable Richmond District of San Francisco. Built in 1971, the building features four (4) large 2-bedroom units: one 2-bed/2-bath, two 2-bed/1.5-bath, and one 2-bed/1-bath, offering flexibility for a variety of investor strategies. Community amenities include secure garage parking for all units, on-site laundry facilities, and well-maintained common areas. Recent capital improvements feature upgraded electrical panels and a newly constructed rear staircase. Don't miss this chance to own a rare, well-located four-plex in one of San Francisco's most stable rental markets.
